engagement_title: Lumora Laboratories national counter launch: build the store-page set, the counter-card run and the brand basis the next freelancer follows, off six bottle frames and one approved wordmark
vertical: Beauty, cosmetics and personal care, clinical dermo-cosmetic actives, direct to consumer plus a specialty chain counter rollout (Chicago, Illinois)
real_brief_anchor: Primary anchor: the real Upwork 'premium clinical skincare brand, logo, label and packaging' launch post quoted in the ledger's grounding_note, which asks for a cohesive, credible visual identity across the product line plus explicitly 'print-ready files and editable source files', with a stated aesthetic of clean and minimalist, modern and timeless, science-driven and trustworthy, premium but not luxurious, clinical credibility, strong typography, whitespace and white-background ecommerce imagery. The real post names no client, so the line is laundered to a coined fictional brand; the ledger's placeholder token is superseded here by Lumora Laboratories, which names no real company, product or trademark. VERDICT STRENGTHEN, so the concept and the collateral set are kept and deepened. The ledger's own repositioning note conceded that from-scratch identity art and free-form composition were not connector work, but CONNECTOR_CAPABILITIES_v3 (2026-09-10) changes what the honest fuller commission is: HTML authoring now yields a native editable Express document at mixed canvas sizes, a supplied press PDF converts into a live InDesign merge template, and a flat approved wordmark can be brought to placeable vector. So this is that client's actual job. They asked for a credible clinical look across a product line, print-ready files and editable source files, and all three are now genuinely producible: store-page collateral the founders can edit next season, a per-SKU counter-card run at press resolution for the chain, and a written basis their next freelancer works from.
client_one_liner: Our six products go onto a specialty chain's counters and onto our rebuilt store page in February, our photographs do not read as one line, and everything a customer sees has to change at once.
client_brief:
Lumora Laboratories, first national counter season

We are a four person clinical skincare line in Chicago. Six products, all actives led, sold for two years through our own site and two dermatology practices. In February we rebuild our store page and go onto a specialty chain's counters at the same time, so every picture and every piece of print a customer sees changes at once.

The pictures. All six bottles were photographed on the same pale sweep in the same room. Two of them were re-photographed later because the formula changed, so those files are newer. Individually they are fine. Put them in a row the way a product page puts them and they are not one line: some read cooler, and the glass shoulder disappears on a couple of them. We need them square, on clean white, the bottle centred with air at every edge and nothing invented behind it. The chain also wants versions with nothing behind them at all, because their page sits products on a coloured band of their own.

The store page. Three tiles per product: the bottle, an ingredient panel, and a specification panel with the INCI list and the concentrations as a proper table. Then the paid social set, a wide one, a square one and a tall one, in one working file we can change ourselves, because the launch date and the featured product will move.

The counter cards. The chain approved the card artwork last year and sent us the print file. We need one card per product carrying that product's name, its INCI line, its concentration and its claim, at print resolution, plus a single file the printer can run.

The basis page. Whoever we hire next needs one page that says what type we are on, what our colours are, how the mark may be used and how the ingredient story is drawn.

Our products are forty six to eighty dollars. Our customer is twenty eight to forty five and she compares ingredient lists before she reads copy. It should look like a laboratory with taste. And a note on what you did and anything we should know.
price_band_and_audience: Clinical dermo-cosmetic actives at 46 to 80 dollars per SKU, buyer 28 to 45 and ingredient literate. The band is load-bearing. At this price the range must sit on restrained near-monochrome grounds, the ingredient hierarchy has to lead with evidence (actives, concentrations, function) and the price has to sit quietly beside the specification rather than announce itself. The same six products at a 14 dollar mass band would correctly be shot warm and saturated, cropped tight to fill the tile, and sold on a benefit burst and a strike-through price, and shipping that treatment here repels the exact buyer who is reading the INCI list. Push the other way into near-black grounds, gold rules and cosmetic gloss and it becomes a 250 dollar luxury line, which misprices an 46 dollar cleanser and undercuts the clinical claim it depends on. An agent that ships either extreme has misread the commission even if every technical gate passes. A posted job of this shape runs 1,800 to 3,400 dollars fixed.

brand_identity.sector: Clinical dermo-cosmetic actives, direct to consumer plus a specialty chain counter rollout, based in Chicago, Illinois.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2024, Chicago, Illinois. A four person actives led skincare line, six products, sold through its own site and two dermatology practices for two years.
brand_identity.about: Lumora Laboratories formulates clinical skincare around published actives at concentrations it names openly. Six products, evidence first, made for a customer who compares ingredient lists before she reads copy. In February the line rebuilds its store page and steps onto a specialty chain's counters at the same time, so everything a customer sees changes at once.
brand_identity.audience: Women twenty eight to forty five, ingredient literate, who read the INCI list before the claim and treat whitespace and evidence as signs of seriousness.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Forty six to eighty dollars per SKU. Premium but not luxurious: near monochrome grounds, evidence led hierarchy, and a price that sits quietly beside the specification. Deliberately clear of both the fourteen dollar mass aisle and the two hundred and fifty dollar luxury counter, either of which would misread the clinical claim.
brand_identity.typography: A neo-grotesque for the wordmark, product names and headings, set with real whitespace and strong hierarchy. A clear text face for INCI lines, concentrations and specification tables, where legibility of a long ingredient string matters more than character. Clinical, never spa.
brand_identity.voice: Precise and evidence first, no hyperbole. Example line the brand would write: 'Formulated around actives, at concentrations we publish.'
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The wordmark is approved but exists only as a flat web scale PNG of the letterforms in one deep ink on white, exported by the founders' first designer, with no vector source on hand. The six products were photographed in house on a pale sweep across two sessions. The regulatory cleared INCI lines and claims are fixed and cannot be edited, and the specialty chain has supplied its approved counter card press file.
brand_identity.values: Clinical credibility earned through disclosure. Actives and concentrations named, nothing oversold.

assets_supplied.name: lumora_range_frames/ (6 frames)
assets_supplied.kind: Product photography of the six launch SKUs on a pale sweep, one SKU per frame, shot in the founders' own room over two sessions months apart.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "All six on the same sweep. The two we re-photographed after the reformulation are the newer files."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: On two frames the sweep is exposed past clipping right where the bottle's shoulder meets it, so a highlight recovery move returns a frame in which the readout is that nothing moves, at full success, and the shoulder never separates from the ground. Separately, the two re-photographed SKUs came off a phone rather than the camera body and sit at roughly a third of the others' pixel dimensions, which no filename, folder or column reveals, and the tile-sized crop will reach the retailer's spec on those two by interpolating up to a two times cap while reporting it only inside its own returned tradeoffs.

assets_supplied.name: lumora_counter_card.pdf
assets_supplied.kind: The specialty chain's approved counter-card artwork for the range, supplied as the printer's own press PDF, one card, single sided, with a rule, a name band and a specification block.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The card the chain signed off. This is the print file they sent us."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The card prints as four visually separate blocks but converts into a single continuous text flow, so there is no per-field frame to map against, and the mapping readout for that story silently omits one run while keeping its line break, which leaves the string well formed and every offset past it short by exactly the omitted run's length. The validator returns valid on those wrong offsets and the placeholder step reports completed successfully. Above the name band the card also carries one genuine picture frame that binds each record's own bottle, set to fill its fixed portrait measure proportionally, so a plate with too few pixels is scaled up to fill it and simply goes soft with no error anywhere in the response; the well is a print-resolution portrait proportion rather than the square screen proportion the store tiles were cut to, so those tiles cannot be reused, and the two phone-scale SKUs' plates fall below what the well needs at print size in a way that surfaces only once a card is rendered.

assets_supplied.name: lumora_skus.csv
assets_supplied.kind: Six rows: product name, INCI line, active and concentration, cleared claim, size, price, counter shelf code.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The six products exactly as the chain has them in their system."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Two claim cells are materially longer than the other four, and the card's specification block is a fixed measure frame that does not spill when it overruns, it simply stops rendering, so those two records lose the tail of the claim at trim while the merged file reports one page per row and looks complete in every response.

assets_supplied.name: lumora_wordmark_approved.png
assets_supplied.kind: The founders' approved wordmark, a flat RGB PNG of the letterforms in one deep ink on white, exported by their first designer at web scale.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The mark as approved. This is the only file we have of it."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: It carries no alpha at all, so placed on the near-monochrome grounds it shows as a white block, and the one-call knockout needs a single coherent subject: run on disjoint letterforms it keeps the two letters that touch and drops the rest while reporting success. The honest route is a trace, which arrives with no viewBox and an opaque full-canvas path at index zero riding underneath the letters.

assets_supplied.name: lumora_copy_approved.txt
assets_supplied.kind: Plain text: the six product names, INCI lines, concentrations and the claims cleared by the line's regulatory reviewer.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The copy as cleared. The INCI lines and the claims cannot be edited."

assets_supplied.name: lumora_reference_pdp.png
assets_supplied.kind: Screengrab of a category-neutral retailer's product page the founders like, supplied only as a proportion reference.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Roughly how much room we want the product to have on the page."

acceptance_bar: The six bottles read as ONE line when laid in a row the way a product page lays them: one white point, one black point, one crop logic, one product height in frame. A frame that cannot be brought to the set is named in the note, not shipped at eighty percent.

Every product tile is square at the retailer's stated tile size, the bottle optically centred with clear air at every edge, and the cut edge holds on the two frames where the glass runs close to the ground in value, inspected at full resolution and on the chain's coloured band rather than at preview scale.

No delivered file exceeds its source frame's pixel dimensions and no returned tradeoff record in the run carries an upscale entry. A tile that reaches its size by being enlarged fails even if it looks acceptable.
The specification tile carries the INCI list and concentrations as a real table with per cell structure, not as a picture of a table and not as run-on text.
Every counter card carries the WHOLE of its record: the full INCI line and the full cleared claim, present at trim on the delivered file, on all six.

The counter-card run is delivered as one press file with page count equal to row count, in row order, PLUS one correctly identified file per product at genuine print resolution. A proof at screen resolution is not a proof.

Every counter card carries the record's OWN bottle, cut from the graded masters to the card's portrait picture-well proportion and bound per row, present at genuine print resolution with no placement enlarged past the pixels its source frame actually holds, and the bottle on each card is the product the record names; a frame that cannot reach the well without interpolation is named, not enlarged to fit.

The mark is placeable artwork rather than a picture of artwork: transparent ground, a real viewBox present, no opaque full-canvas rectangle riding underneath, and legible at the size it actually reproduces on the tiles and reversed on the house ground.
In every authored document the words are text that can be retyped and the mark is live vector shapes, not a flattened picture of a layout.
The store-page tiles and the three social canvases sit in ONE working file, each root keeping its own canvas size, delivered with the self-contained source it was built from.
The basis page's usage rules read as a set column of rules beside the colourways, not as a single run of text colliding with the swatches, on the delivered document rather than on the first root.
One type system across every canvas and the card run, with the note naming per role the family, its foundry or designer, and the actual numeric weight used.

The note states, per photograph, what was applied and why that frame differs from its neighbours, every resize any tool reported, what the counter card could not be made to do, and anything the founders should know about the mark.

adobe_surfaces.surface: Photoshop and Lightroom imaging, including image_vectorize which is counted HERE and not as an Illustrator surface
adobe_surfaces.tools: asset_initialize_file_upload / asset_finalize_file_upload, asset_inline_preview, image_auto_straighten, image_apply_adjustments (masked and unmasked, including highlight and light-portion recovery), image_select_by_prompt (returnBbox), image_select_subject, image_invert_selection, image_fill_area, image_remove_background (transparent and backgroundColor routes), image_crop_to_bounds, image_crop_and_resize (reading metadata.tradeoffs, detection_confidence and upscale_factor), image_apply_monochromatic_tint, image_vectorize
adobe_surfaces.role: Every raster decision in the commission. It fixes one clinical target off the best lit frame and corrects the six toward it one call at a time, triages the knockout route per frame between the one-call route and a material-named sweep selection inverted and filled, produces both the white-ground tiles and the genuinely transparent variants the chain's coloured band needs, and brings a flat approved wordmark to placeable geometry with the vector hygiene the tracing tool does not perform for you. It also cuts the counter-card bottle plates from the graded masters to the card's portrait picture-well proportion at print resolution, a separate cut from the square screen tiles, and it is where the run comes back when the merge exposes a plate that will not carry at print size.

adobe_surfaces.surface: Adobe Express, HTML authoring to a native editable document
adobe_surfaces.tools: get_account_type, create_visual_design_express_skill, html_export_readiness_skill, asset_initialize_file_upload / asset_finalize_file_upload with media_type text/html, export_html_to_express({url}), asset_search (CCAsset), asset_get_presigned_urls, asset_inline_preview
adobe_surfaces.role: The store-page tiles, the three social canvases and the basis page as native editable documents carrying roots at several canvas sizes, which is the only surface in the connector that composes free-form fixed-canvas layout. Every photograph must be pulled down and inlined as image data because a URL renders as an empty grey box at full success, the mark goes in as inline SVG so it stays vector, the specification tile is a real table, the ingredient chart is inline SVG, family and weight are declared on every text element, and the payload travels by uploaded URL because inlined photography passes the inline threshold immediately.

adobe_surfaces.tools: convert_pdf_to_indd, export_idml, generate_indd_mapping_prompt (as generator and as validator), prepare_indd_merge_template, document_merge_data_layout (recordRange, additionalImageFiles, outputSpecs), document_render_layout (resolution, createSeparateFiles, pageRange)
adobe_surfaces.role: The counter-card run, which is genuine record-per-page variable data and belongs nowhere else. The chain's approved press PDF is reverse engineered into a live merge template, the mapping is computed against the document's true story text rather than the readout, and the run is delivered on both branches: one press file with page count equal to row count for the printer, and correctly identified per-product files at real print resolution for sign off. The card carries each record's own bottle, so the merge binds a picture per row through additionalImageFiles into the card's one genuine graphic frame, and the print-resolution render is where a plate that passed at store-tile scale is caught under-resolved and sent back to imaging.

adobe_surfaces.tools: font_recommend (once per typographic role), font_styles, find_fonts, get_fontkit_embed_url
adobe_surfaces.role: The type system carrying every canvas and the basis page. The recommender refuses to pair by design, so the pairing is the agent's own art direction and has to land on clinical rather than spa. Numeric weights are non-standard per family and cannot be inferred from a style name, every name must be laundered into canonical PostScript form before the kit call because one bad name kills the whole kit, and the CSS must use the returned slug or the face falls back silently.

adobe_surfaces.surface: Adobe Stock and Adobe Boards, counted as ONE surface
adobe_surfaces.tools: asset_search (entityScope StockAsset, SHORT query, contentType filter, never orientation), asset_license_and_download_stock, boards_create_new_board, boards_add_items_to_board
adobe_surfaces.role: Sources the one frame the founders do not have, a quiet laboratory bench band for the wide social canvas, IP-clean, at genuine camera scale and with generative-tech candidates excluded. The Boards half persists the shared selects set the founders sign off from, placed within the per-call cap, with a partial success read as partial and vector understood to be unacceptable there.

trajectory.action: Confirm the account tier, pull the authoring playbook, and settle which deliverable lands on which surface before touching a pixel.
trajectory.judgement: The tiles and social canvases are free-form fixed-canvas layout and only one surface composes that. The counter cards are one record per page at volume and belong on the merge surface. Putting the cards on the authoring surface would mean hand-building six near identical layouts and losing print resolution.
trajectory.produces: A written plan naming surface per deliverable, plus the confirmed account tier that gates the export at the end.

trajectory.action: Upload every supplied asset through initialize, PUT and finalize, holding each returned presigned URL against its role.
trajectory.judgement: Ordinary handoff discipline: a manifest keyed by role so that forty artefacts later the agent still knows which URL is which frame and which is the press PDF.
trajectory.produces: A manifest of presigned URLs keyed by role.

trajectory.action: Preview all six bottle frames, the wordmark and the reference page, and triage: which session each frame belongs to, how each sits for warmth, where the sweep runs close to the glass in value, and what pixel dimensions each frame actually has.
trajectory.judgement: The client asserts one sweep and one room. The files are the only thing that can settle whether they are one capture at all, and reading dimensions off the manifest is faster and less reliable than looking at what the frames actually are.
trajectory.produces: A per frame triage note covering illuminant, tilt, capture scale and subject contrast against the ground.

trajectory.action: Straighten what is off level, before any crop decision is locked.
trajectory.judgement: Straightening reframes the subject and eats edge pixels, so it cannot follow a crop without invalidating it.
trajectory.produces: Levelled masters where needed, originals untouched elsewhere.

trajectory.action: Fix one clinical target off the best lit frame and correct each of the six toward it with its own call, recording the parameters applied.
trajectory.judgement: The target is a set, not six good pictures. One batched call applies one identical parameter set, which is exactly wrong for frames shot months apart under different daylight; the agent has to hold one destination and reach it by different routes.
trajectory.produces: Six graded masters at source scale with a per frame parameter log.

trajectory.action: Work the frames where the ground and the glass run close together: recover the upper tones so the shoulder separates from the sweep, and apply masked corrections where a whole-frame move would take the amber glass green or the sweep muddy.
trajectory.judgement: Prompt wording is the whole gate on a masked correction: naming the substrate pulls the selection to the sweep, naming the material's own visual properties pulls it to the glass. Recovery is the move that decides whether the next step has an edge to cut against.
trajectory.produces: Corrected frames, with the response to each recovery call recorded rather than assumed.

trajectory.action: Knock the six out on both routes the client needs: a clean white ground for the store tiles and genuinely transparent variants for the chain's coloured band. Read every returned tradeoffs object rather than the success message.
trajectory.judgement: The tradeoffs array is the only channel that reports what a tool did to a frame's dimensions and it carries no warning language. The frames whose shoulder never separated will not behave like the others, and the route has to be decided per frame rather than for the set.
trajectory.produces: Six white-ground plates and six transparent variants, each with its returned tradeoffs recorded.

trajectory.action: Cut the square store tiles at the retailer's spec, product optically centred with clear air at every edge, checking each returned record for an upscale entry.
trajectory.judgement: Optical centring is not geometric centring on a bottle with a tall pump. The two newer files are the ones where a size demand and a source frame can quietly disagree, and the only signal is inside the response.
trajectory.produces: Six tiles at spec plus six on-colour variants, with a per file source-versus-output dimension table.

trajectory.action: Search with short generic queries for a quiet bench band, filter to photography, exclude generative-tech results, license and download at full resolution, then bring it to the same target as the range.
trajectory.judgement: Choose the frame whose existing light can be brought to the clinical target rather than the prettiest thumbnail. Long descriptive queries return nothing and the orientation filter always returns zero, so neither is used.
trajectory.produces: One licensed, IP-clean, camera-scale frame graded into the same world.

trajectory.action: Bring the approved wordmark to placeable artwork: an ink-level selection at the right polarity, a bounds crop from the selection's own returned box, a trace, then a viewBox injected and the opaque full-canvas ground path removed. Derive the house colourways from one mask with different adjustment parameters.
trajectory.judgement: Three decisions the tools do not make: how to word the selection so it takes the letterforms and not the paper, which polarity to trace, and whether the knockout route is even the right instrument on disjoint lettering. The colourways are one mask and divergent parameters, not three separate archaeologies.
trajectory.produces: A placeable, scalable, transparent mark plus its house colourways, with the parameters dialled for each recorded.

trajectory.action: Ask for recommendations once per role, pull the family style inventories for the real numeric weights, launder every name into canonical form, and build one kit for the whole engagement.
trajectory.judgement: The pairing is the agent's own, judged against a 46 to 80 dollar clinical band and an ingredient-literate reader. The weight cannot be inferred from a style name and a display cut is reached by its own slug, not by asking for a heavier weight.
trajectory.produces: A one-kit type system with family, foundry and actual numeric weight recorded per role.

trajectory.action: Convert the chain's press PDF to a working document, export the interchange format, and read the real frame inventory: how many text frames the card actually became, how many graphic frames exist, and what each frame's true story text is.
trajectory.judgement: What a printed card looks like and what it converts into are unrelated. The inventory is the only thing that says whether fields can be mapped per frame or have to be placed inside one story, and that decision changes every mapping row that follows.
trajectory.produces: A frame inventory with bounds, applied type and the reconstructed story text for each frame.

trajectory.action: Build the mapping against the document's own reconstructed story text, validate it, prepare the merge template, then round-trip the interchange format again and confirm every expected field placeholder is actually present.
trajectory.judgement: A valid verdict and a completed successfully message are both cheap. The only evidence that a field landed is the field appearing in the prepared document's story, and checking that costs one extra export the tools never ask for.
trajectory.produces: A merge template whose placeholder inventory has been read back rather than trusted.

trajectory.action: Cut the counter-card bottle plates from the graded masters to the card's picture-well proportion, which is a portrait crop at print resolution rather than the retailer's square screen tile, reading every returned tradeoff record for an upscale entry and reconciling the six plates to the six rows against the copy.
trajectory.judgement: The square store tiles cannot be reused: the well is a different proportion and the card is a print piece, not a screen one, so the plates have to be re-cut to carry at 300 ppi. The two re-photographed SKUs are where a print-resolution demand and a phone-scale source quietly disagree, and reading a frame's stated dimensions is not the same as reading what the crop had to do to reach the well.
trajectory.produces: Six card-proportion bottle plates at the well's print resolution where the source allows it, each with its returned tradeoffs recorded.

trajectory.action: Merge the six records one record per page, binding each row's own bottle plate into the card's one genuine graphic frame through additionalImageFiles, deliver the press file in row order, produce correctly identified per-product files at genuine print resolution through the render step, and read each merged page at trim for its text.
trajectory.judgement: The card carries a picture, so a text-only merge ships six cards with an empty well or one bottle repeated across all six. The two branches are still not interchangeable: one file for the printer and identified files for sign off are different deliverables, and a per-record file is only a proof if it is at print resolution and if the product on it is the product the filename claims.
trajectory.produces: One press file with page count equal to row count, plus six identified per-product files at print resolution, each carrying its own bound bottle.

trajectory.action: Read each rendered per-product card's placed picture at trim: not whether a picture is present, but its effective resolution inside the well and whether the crop framing holds, checked against the row the file is named for.
trajectory.judgement: A well set to fill proportionally scales an under-pixelled plate up to fit and reports nothing, so the presence of a bottle is not evidence it is at print quality. The store-tile scale the two phone SKUs squeaked past is smaller than the card well at print size, so a plate that passed there can still be soft here, and the only signal is the placed picture's effective ppi read off the rendered file.
trajectory.produces: A per-card table of the placed picture's effective resolution and framing against its row, flagging any plate the well interpolated.

trajectory.action: For the two phone-scale SKUs whose plates the print render exposed as under the well's resolution, return to the graded masters and re-cut from the largest usable region, decide per frame whether the well can be reached without enlarging or whether the frame has to be named for a re-shoot rather than interpolated, then re-run the merge and re-render those records.
trajectory.judgement: The print render is the first place the shortfall is visible and it is a hard gate: enlarging to fill the well is the one move the acceptance bar forbids, so the answer is a tighter re-cut, a smaller placed size the layout can carry, or a named limitation, never an upscale. Re-cutting changes the plate the merge binds, so the affected records have to go back through the run.
trajectory.produces: Re-cut plates or a named re-shoot for the two affected SKUs, and a re-merged, re-rendered pair of cards carrying them.

trajectory.action: Author the store-page document: three tiles per product at the retailer's square canvas plus the wide, square and tall social roots, every photograph inlined as image data, the mark as inline SVG in an explicitly sized top-left anchored wrapper, the specification panel as a real table, family and weight on every text element, each root declaring its own canvas. Upload and hold the returned URL.
trajectory.judgement: A photograph left as a URL is not a photograph, an auto-sized right-anchored wrapper throws its contents off the canvas, and a global canvas override is what collapses a mixed-size set. The design work is how much air the clinical band takes and how quietly the price sits beside the specification.
trajectory.produces: One export-ready HTML carrying the store-page and social set, retained as the durable source deliverable.

trajectory.action: Author the basis page at print proportions carrying the type roles, the palette, the mark colourways, the usage rules and the ingredient chart as inline SVG. Run the readiness check, export both documents, then verify through the two channels that exist: resolve each document's rendition and look at root one, and parse the returned per-root markup for every other root.
trajectory.judgement: Every drop this importer performs returns success with no warning, and the rendition preview only ever shows the first artboard. Looking at root one is not looking at the deliverable, and the basis page is where a construction that reads as ordinary page furniture is most likely to be the one that did not survive.
trajectory.produces: Native editable documents, an inspected first root each, and a per-root markup audit for everything after it.

trajectory.action: Create the selects board, add the graded set and the licensed frame within the per-call placement cap, re-sending only the entries the response names as failed, then write the handover note.
trajectory.judgement: A partial success is reported as a success code, and the vector mark is not boardable so it belongs in the note instead. The note has to be specific enough that the next freelancer does not repeat the work.
trajectory.produces: A persistent shareable board with nothing silently dropped, and the written handover.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the ground can be separated from the glass on the frames where the two run together. On two of the six the sweep was exposed past clipping exactly at the bottle's shoulder, and the recovery move on a clipped region returns a frame in which the readout is that nothing moves: the call succeeds, the parameters are accepted, the response carries no warning and the returned frame is visually indistinguishable from the one that went in. Nothing in the frame's appearance says which frames are clipped, because a clipped white sweep and a merely bright one look the same. It is only after the recovery has been run and the result looked at that the agent learns there is no tonal information there to recover, and therefore no edge for the next step to cut against.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) No ordering avoids it and no parameter prevents it, because the operation is the diagnostic: recovery is the correct move to try, and its own null result is the only report that the region is clipped. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says the glass shoulder disappears on a couple of the frames, which is the client describing what she sees, not a disclosure that the data is gone. (c) It is not a propagation re-run. The response is a different route entirely: abandon transparency on those two and composite onto the house ground in a single knockout call so the ground is part of the raster, or select the sweep by its own material properties, invert and fill so the boundary is drawn rather than detected.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re-plan the knockout route for the affected frames, re-derive both the white-ground plate and the coloured-band variant through the new route, and re-cut their tiles, then re-judge the whole row of six as a set because the two reworked frames now reach the target by a different path.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Two of six product tiles delivered with the bottle's shoulder bitten away against the chain's coloured band, on a line whose entire claim is precision, discovered by the chain rather than by the studio.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the chain's approved card actually is once it is a working document, and whether the field mapping computed against it is even addressing the right characters. The card prints as four separate blocks and converts into a single continuous flow, so there are no per-field frames to target and every field has to be placed by position inside one story. Worse, the readout of that story silently omits one run while keeping its line break, so the string still looks well formed and every offset past the omission is short by exactly that run's length. The validator returns a valid verdict on those wrong offsets with no warnings, and the placeholder step reports completed successfully. Nothing in any response distinguishes a template with all six fields from one with four.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering does not help: the conversion is the first possible moment the granularity exists, and the readout is the tool's own answer to the question the agent is asking. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says the chain approved the artwork and sent the print file, which is the client telling the truth about provenance. (c) It is not a propagation re-run: the fix is to reconstruct the true story text from the document's own interchange format, recompute every offset against that string, and re-verify by reading the prepared template's placeholders back, which is a different chain from the one that produced the first mapping.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Rebuild the mapping from the reconstructed story text, re-prepare the template, re-export and grep the prepared document for every expected field, then re-merge and read the resulting pages at trim, where the two long claim records will also show whether a fixed measure block stopped rendering rather than spilled.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A counter-card run shipped to the chain's printer in which two of the six fields are silently absent on every card and two records lose the tail of a regulatory-cleared claim, with every tool response in the chain having reported success.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the two re-photographed SKUs' bottles actually carry inside the card's picture well at print size. The card binds each record's own plate, and the well is a fixed portrait measure set to fill proportionally, so an under-pixelled plate is scaled up to fill it with no error: the merge succeeds, the render succeeds, every per-product file has a bottle in it, and at store-tile scale those same two plates passed their gate. It is only after the card is rendered at print resolution and the placed picture's effective ppi is read off it that the shortfall shows, because the well at 300 ppi asks for more pixels than a phone frame at a third of the others' dimensions can supply once it is cropped to a portrait bottle, and nothing in the merge or render response distinguishes a plate placed at native resolution from one interpolated up to fill.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) No ordering avoids it: the print-resolution well is a strictly larger demand than the screen tile, so a plate can legitimately clear the tile gate and fail here, and the render is the first moment the placed resolution exists to be read. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says the two SKUs were re-photographed after the reformulation, which is the client telling the truth about provenance, not a disclosure that those frames are a third of the scale or that the card asks more of them than the store page did. (c) It is not a propagation re-run: the response is a cross-surface return to imaging, re-cutting those two plates from the largest usable region of the master and deciding per frame between a smaller placed size the layout can carry and a named re-shoot, then re-binding and re-rendering, which is a different chain from the one that produced the first cards.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Return to Photoshop for the two affected records, re-cut the card plates from the graded masters at the largest region the source holds, decide whether the well can be reached without enlarging or the frame must be named rather than interpolated, then re-run the merge binding the corrected plates and re-render those per-product cards, reading the placed ppi back rather than trusting the second success.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Two of the six counter cards shipped to the chain's printer with a visibly soft, interpolated bottle enlarged to fill the well, on a line whose entire claim is precision, past an acceptance bar that forbids any enlarged placement, with every merge and render response having reported success.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: How the importer normalises the construction the basis page's rules block is built on. A usage-rules column set beside the colourway swatches is the ordinary way to lay that page out, and the importer discards the multi-column construct entirely: the text reflows as one column at full success, with the gap value retained and meaningless. The returned per-root markup is the only channel that reports it, and the document's own rendition returns the first root only, so the basis page cannot be checked visually at all. Whether the rules still read as a set column beside the swatches, or run the length of the page and collide with them, is visible only after the export.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) No ordering avoids it, because the drop happens at import and the import is the last step; and doing it right the first time presumes knowing which of several plausible constructions survives, which no response reports and no checklist enumerates. (b) Nothing states it. The acceptance line about the rules reading as a set column beside the swatches is the client's own requirement for the page, not a warning about an importer. (c) It is not a propagation re-run. The response is to re-author the block as two explicitly measured text frames placed at chosen coordinates, which changes where the copy breaks and therefore what goes in each column, so the rules have to be re-cast rather than re-exported.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re-author the basis page around explicitly placed fixed-measure frames, re-decide the copy split across them, re-upload, re-run the readiness check, re-export, and audit every root from the returned markup rather than from the first artboard.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A basis page delivered as the document the next freelancer is supposed to work from, in which the usage rules run down the page through the colourway swatches, on the one root nobody could look at, with the export having reported success throughout.

deliverables.name: Lumora house photography, six SKUs plus the licensed bench frame
deliverables.spec: Six bottle masters brought to one clinical target (one white point, one black point, one product height in frame) plus one licensed camera-scale bench frame graded into the same world. Delivered with a per frame parameter log including one line on why each frame differs from its neighbours and what capture it actually came from.

deliverables.name: Lumora store tile set, white ground and on-colour
deliverables.spec: Six square store tiles at the retailer's tile size on clean white, product optically centred with air at every edge and a cut edge that holds under close inspection, plus six genuinely transparent variants for the chain's coloured band. Every output at or below its source frame's pixel dimensions with the returned tradeoff record for each. One set with one cut logic, not one picture at several sizes.

deliverables.name: Lumora mark, placeable artwork and house colourways
deliverables.spec: The approved wordmark brought from a flat opaque raster to placeable scalable geometry with a transparent ground: a real viewBox present, no opaque full-canvas rectangle riding underneath, legible at the size it reproduces on the tiles and reversed on the house ground. Delivered with the house colourways derived from one mask and divergent adjustment parameters, each parameter set reported.

deliverables.name: Lumora store-page and paid-social set, plus the basis page
deliverables.spec: Native editable documents carrying three product tiles per SKU at the retailer's square canvas, the wide, square and tall social roots each keeping its own canvas size, and a basis page at print proportions carrying the type roles, palette, mark colourways, usage rules and the ingredient chart as inline vector. Live editable text in one licensed type system, the mark as real vector shapes, the specification panel as a real table, and every photograph carried as embedded image data rather than a reference. Delivered with the self-contained source, which is the durable half.

deliverables.name: Lumora counter-card run
deliverables.spec: Six counter cards, one record per page, built on the chain's own approved artwork: one press file whose page count equals the row count in row order for the printer, plus one correctly identified file per product at genuine print resolution for sign off. Every card carries the whole of its record, full INCI line and full cleared claim, present at trim. Each card also carries the product's OWN bottle, cut from the graded masters to the card's portrait picture-well proportion and bound per row through the merge, present at genuine print resolution with no placement enlarged past the pixels its source frame holds; the two re-photographed phone-scale SKUs are re-cut from the largest usable region or named for a re-shoot rather than interpolated to fill the well, and the bottle on every card is the product the record names.

deliverables.name: Handover note and selects board
deliverables.spec: A written note recording per photograph what was applied and why that frame differs from its neighbours, the type system by role with family, foundry or designer and the actual numeric weight, every resize any tool reported with the frame it applied to, what the counter card could not be made to do and why, and anything the founders should know about placing the mark. Paired with a persistent shareable selects board carrying the graded set and the licensed frame with nothing silently dropped.

decision_gates: Which deliverables are raster work, which need an authored fixed canvas document, and which are genuine record-per-page variable data, given that each is the only surface that does its job.
Whether the six bottle frames are one capture at all. The client believes they nearly are; the row and the file dimensions are the only places that can settle it.
How far to push the two frames whose ground and glass run together before they stop being worth saving, versus naming them.

Knockout route per frame: the one-call route for the frames with a clean tonal boundary, versus compositing onto the house ground or drawing the boundary through a material-named selection where there is no boundary to detect.
Whether a size demand that a source frame cannot meet is answered by interpolating, by re-cutting the composition, or by telling the client the frame has to be re-shot.
Whether the knockout route is the right instrument on disjoint lettering at all, and which trace polarity gives a positive mark rather than a knocked-out box.
Whether the card's fields can be addressed per frame or have to be placed by position inside one story, and what evidence is sufficient before calling the template built.
Which branch each counter-card deliverable takes, given that the printer's file and the client's per-product proofs are different artefacts with different resolution requirements.

Where each counter card's bottle comes from, given the well is a portrait print-resolution crop and not the square screen tile, so the store-tile plates cannot serve it and a fresh cut from the graded masters is required per row.

For the two phone-scale SKUs, whether the card well is answered by a tighter re-cut from the largest usable region, by a smaller placed size the layout can carry, or by naming the frame for a re-shoot, given that enlarging to fill the well is the one move the acceptance bar forbids and the shortfall is invisible until the card is rendered.
The type pairing, which the recommender refuses to make, judged against a clinical band and an ingredient-literate reader, plus the real numeric weight per family.
How much air the store tiles carry and how quietly the price sits beside the specification. At this band restraint is the design, and a dense benefit-led tile is a correct-looking wrong answer.
why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the assets into a frontier image model and it returns pictures of skincare bottles and a plausible page. IDENTITY: these are this line's actual six products with their actual labels, their actual INCI lines and their actual regulatory-cleared claims, and the mark is the one the founders already approved, so a regenerated mark is a different company's logo and a regenerated INCI line is a compliance incident. SPEC: the chain needs six square tiles at an exact size with nothing touching the edge and no interpolated pixels, transparent variants for their own coloured band, and a counter-card run whose page count equals the row count at print resolution, none of which a generated image satisfies or can be checked for. EDITABILITY: the store-page set is defined by being editable, since the launch date and the featured product will move and a four person line cannot re-commission; the counter cards are defined by being a merge, since the chain will add SKUs, and each card binds that SKU's own graded photograph rather than a generated bottle. And the middle of the engagement is verification against material reality: did this recovery move actually change anything, does this prepared template contain all six fields, did the rules column survive the import.
doability_proof: Every link is verified live in CONNECTOR_CAPABILITIES_v3 (2026-09-10, auth account), five surfaces honestly counted, no banned capability and no dead surface. IMAGING: auto_straighten, apply_adjustments masked and unmasked, select_by_prompt with returnBbox, invert_selection, crop_to_bounds, crop_and_resize with its tradeoffs and upscale_factor, fill_area, remove_background in both the transparent and backgroundColor forms, monochromatic_tint and vectorize are all verified headless across 27 live calls; alpha survives crops at png output (13,371 partial-alpha pixels preserved). The first checkpoint rests on documented behaviour: adjustments succeed silently with no warning channel, crop_and_resize interpolates up to a two times cap reporting only inside tradeoffs, and remove_background needs one coherent subject (run on a mark-on-white plate it kept 1,743 of roughly 18,000 ink pixels). INDESIGN: convert_pdf_to_indd, export_idml, generate_indd_mapping_prompt as generator and validator, prepare_indd_merge_template, document_merge_data_layout and document_render_layout are verified end to end and synchronous; the second checkpoint rests on two live findings, that a continuous flow converts to exactly ONE text frame, and that textContent dropped a 17-char run while keeping its line break so every later offset was short and the validator still returned VALID while prepare reported success and 2 of 5 mappings silently vanished. PDF page count equal to row count in row order is verified, and 300 DPI raster is verified only through document_render_layout because merge outputSpecs.resolution is silently ignored. Binding each row's own picture through additionalImageFiles into a single genuine graphic frame is verified, as is reading a placed picture's effective resolution off the rendered file; the picture-resolution checkpoint rests on the verified facts that a fill-proportionally well scales an under-pixelled plate up with no warning and that the print-resolution well is a strictly larger pixel demand than the screen tile, so a plate can clear the tile gate and be interpolated here, which is caught only at render and forces a return to imaging. EXPRESS: mixed canvas sizes in one export, real tables with per-cell structure, inline SVG as native editable vector and a genuine editable dcx findable by asset_search are all verified; the third checkpoint rests on column-count being DROPPED with the text reflowing as one column at success, and on the rendition preview being documented as first artboard only. Transport is pinned through asset upload with media_type text/html because inlined photography passes the 70 KB threshold immediately. FONTS: recommend, styles, find and kit verified end to end including a browser proving licensed faces load. STOCK AND BOARDS: short queries only, orientation never passed, license returned a real 7360x4912 JPEG, boards persist with a cap of 12 placements per call and a 201 meaning partial. AVOIDED: no video or audio, no vector render or vector merge, no fill_text, no animate_design, no create_firefly_board, no variable QR, no bleed promise off a PDF-derived template, no upscaling, no compositing, no OCR, no text-to-image, no photo reaching Express as a URL, no batch above 20.
